text: The concept of Todoist is very nice: it is crossplatfrom and you can link tasks to Gmail and Outlook messages. However, it is not possible to filter on labels in the free Todoist app. This makes it unsuitable to use for GTD purposes. The web app is better in this respect, it allows filtering (though you cannot store your filters). I find paying $29 a year too much to get the extra features. So this otherwise nice app is not for me.
